results.question: How many orders are in the dataset in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders LIMIT 500

results.question: How many orders were delivered in 2017?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND purchase_date >= '2017-01-01' AND purchase_date < '2018-01-01' LIMIT 500

results.question: How many unique customers are there?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM marts.dim_customers LIMIT 500

results.question: How many sellers are on the marketplace?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sellers FROM marts.dim_sellers LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average review score across all reviewed orders?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL LIMIT 500

results.question: How many orders were canceled?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the cancellation rate across all orders?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM marts.fct_orders LIMIT 500

results.question: How many products are in the catalog?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_in_catalog FROM marts.dim_products LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 500

results.question: What share of delivered orders arrived late?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS late_delivery_rate, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the average order value in 2018?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS aov FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND purchase_date >= '2018-01-01' AND purchase_date < '2019-01-01' LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the revenue from delivered orders in each year?
results.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM purchase_date) AS order_year, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM purchase_date) ORDER BY order_year LIMIT 500

results.question: Which 5 customer states placed the most orders?
results.sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which 5 product categories generated the highest item revenue (sum of item prices) from delivered orders?
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS item_revenue, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM marts.fct_order_items WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY item_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: How many payments were made with each payment type?
results.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_payment_value FROM marts.fct_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average review score for late versus on time delivered orders?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_late THEN 'Late' ELSE 'On Time' END AS delivery_timeliness, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(CAST(AVG(review_score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND is_late IS NOT NULL GROUP BY is_late ORDER BY is_late DESC LIMIT 500
results.reason: no result column matches expected column 'is_late'

results.question: How many orders were placed each month in 2017?
results.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE purchase_date >= '2017-01-01' AND purchase_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 500
results.reason: no result column matches expected column 'month'

results.question: Which 5 states have the most sellers?
results.sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM marts.dim_sellers GROUP BY state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which 5 cities have the most customers?
results.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest average freight value per delivered order?
results.sql: SELECT customer_state, ROUND(CAST(AVG(freight_value) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_freight_value, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight_value DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What was the late delivery rate for delivered orders in each year?
results.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM purchase_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM purchase_date) ORDER BY order_year LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers have more than one delivered order?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE delivered_order_count > 1 LIMIT 500

results.question: What was the average number of items per delivered order in each year?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM purchase_date) AS INT) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(CAST(AVG(item_count) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS avg_items_per_order FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 500

results.question: Which 5 product categories sold the most items in delivered orders in 2018?
results.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM marts.fct_order_items WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND purchase_date >= '2018-01-01' AND purchase_date < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY category ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which 5 customer states had the highest late delivery rate in 2018?
results.sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND purchase_date >= '2018-01-01' AND purchase_date < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What was the month over month revenue growth rate for each month of 2018?
results.sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT d.month_start, SUM(o.payment_value) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_date AS d ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.purchase_date >= '2018-01-01' AND o.purchase_date < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY d.month_start) SELECT month_start, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 4) AS mom_growth_rate FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month_start LIMIT 500

results.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest average review score, among categories with at least 500 reviewed delivered orders?
results.sql: SELECT i.category, ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.review_score) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS avg_review_score, COUNT(o.order_id) AS reviewed_orders FROM marts.fct_order_items AS i JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE i.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.category HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 500 ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC LIMIT 5
results.reason: no result column matches expected column 'category'

results.question: What is the repeat customer rate?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN is_repeat_customer THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS repeat_customer_rate FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE delivered_order_count > 0 LIMIT 500

results.question: What share of total delivered revenue comes from the top 1,000 customers by lifetime revenue?
results.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM (SELECT lifetime_revenue FROM marts.dim_customers ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000) AS top_customers) / (SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS top_customers_revenue_share LIMIT 500
